"import csv
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation, ROUND_HALF_UP

from docx import Document


CSV_PATH = "load_03.csv"
OUTPUT_PATH = "report.docx"
REQUIRED_COLUMNS = ["case", "load_factor", "cycles"]

with open(CSV_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as csv_file:
    reader = csv.DictReader(csv_file)
    if reader.fieldnames != REQUIRED_COLUMNS:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Expected columns {REQUIRED_COLUMNS}, found {reader.fieldnames}"
        )
    source_rows = list(reader)

rows = []
loads = []
total_cycles = 0

for source_row in source_rows:
    try:
        load = Decimal(source_row["load_factor"].strip())
        cycles_decimal = Decimal(source_row["cycles"].strip())
    except InvalidOperation as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid numeric value in row: {source_row}") from exc

    if not load.is_finite() or not cycles_decimal.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"Non-finite numeric value in row: {source_row}")
    if cycles_decimal != cycles_decimal.to_integral_value():
        raise ValueError(f"Cycle count is not an integer in row: {source_row}")

    cycles = int(cycles_decimal)
    rows.append(
        (
            source_row["case"],
            source_row["load_factor"].strip(),
            source_row["cycles"].strip(),
        )
    )
    loads.append(load)
    total_cycles += cycles

n = len(rows)
if n == 0:
    raise ValueError("The CSV contains no data records.")

load_max = max(loads)
load_mean = sum(loads, Decimal("0")) / Decimal(n)
load_max_display = format(
    load_max.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP), "f"
)
load_mean_display = format(
    load_mean.quantize(Decimal("0.1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP), "f"
)

if (n, load_max_display, load_mean_display, total_cycles) != (
    26,
    "2.39",
    "1.7",
    120035,
):
    raise ValueError("The CSV statistics do not match the required report values.")

document = Document()

document.add_heading("Engineering Test Report", level=0)

document.add_heading("Overview", level=1)
document.add_paragraph(f"The dataset contains {n} data records.")

document.add_heading("Results table", level=1)
table = document.add_table(rows=1, cols=3)
table.style = "Table Grid"

for column_index, column_name in enumerate(REQUIRED_COLUMNS):
    table.cell(0, column_index).text = column_name

for case, load_factor, cycles in rows:
    row_cells = table.add_row().cells
    row_cells[0].text = case
    row_cells[1].text = load_factor
    row_cells[2].text = cycles

document.add_heading("Summary", level=1)
document.add_paragraph(
    f"N cases = {n}; load max = {load_max_display}; "
    f"load mean = {load_mean_display}; total cycles = {total_cycles}."
)

document.add_heading("Conclusion", level=1)
document.add_paragraph(
    "The provided load cases and their cycle counts have been compiled for review."
)

document.save(OUTPUT_PATH)"
